notes: Read-only Tier-1 capture on a healthy running mavlink-camera-manager (Rust binary PID 795, user root, comm mavlink-camera-manager). CPU/RSS via tools/sample_resource.sh (--pid 795, 90 samples, label running_baseline; no active video pipelines). SLO via tools/probe_http.sh on GET /mavlink-camera-manager/v4l and GET /mavlink-camera-manager/streams (--repeats 60). Observed REST API is UNVERSIONED at runtime: routes directly under /mavlink-camera-manager/ with no version prefix (observed_facts versions list empty). NO USB/external cameras attached; GET /streams returns 200 with empty array []. GET /v4l returns 200 listing onboard Pi ISP nodes (bcm2835-isp) and built-in test sources (Fake source, Redirect source) — not an operator-attached camera inventory. GET /info probed once: 201 with version JSON (not counted as healthy baseline). GET /xml probed once: 400 missing field `file` (requires parameters; not counted as healthy baseline). Mutating routes (POST /streams, POST /v4l, DELETE /delete_stream) not exercised (no camera hardware to configure on capture host). Raw evidence: /tmp/mcm_sample.json, /tmp/mcm_slo.json.
